news.title: Sabres F Kulich returns from blood clot issues, nets winner
news.ruTitle: Sabres F Kulich returns from blood clot issues, nets winner
news.description: Nearly a year of worries of whether he was ever going to play again, while he recovered from a blood clot issue, washed away as Buffalo Sabres forward Jiri Kulich scored the go-ahead goal with 6:40 left to secure a 4-3 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks.

news.title: Merilainen makes 23 saves in first start for the Canucks in a 4-1 victory over the Flames
news.ruTitle: Merilainen makes 23 saves in first start for the Canucks in a 4-1 victory over the Flames
news.description: — Leevi Merilainen made 23 saves in his first start for Vancouver and the Canucks had a four-goal third period in a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames on Saturday night.

news.title: Chernyshov's 2nd goal of the game gives the Sharks a 5-4 overtime win over the Kings
news.ruTitle: Chernyshov's 2nd goal of the game gives the Sharks a 5-4 overtime win over the Kings
news.description: — Igor Chernyshov scored his second goal of the game with 1:42 remaining in overtime and the San Jose Sharks beat the Los Angeles Kings 5-4 on Saturday night for their second straight win to open the season.

news.title: Necas and Roy score quick goals as the Avalanche rout the Blues 6-1
news.ruTitle: Necas and Roy score quick goals as the Avalanche rout the Blues 6-1
news.description: — Nicolas Roy and Martin Necas scored 23 seconds apart in a four-goal second period, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kaprizov scores twice as the Wild beat the Bruins 4-1
news.ruTitle: Kaprizov scores twice as the Wild beat the Bruins 4-1
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored twice, Jesper Wallstedt made 26 saves, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Boston Bruins 4-1 on Saturday night.
